# Xboom OS

> Internal business operations system (ERP/CRM) for Xboom — streamlining sales, supply chain, finance, and HR workflows. The application is authentication-gated; only the public drone repair enquiry form is open to the web.

## Pages

- [Drone Repair Enquiry](/public/drone-repair-enquiry): Public form for customers to submit drone repair requests (model, issue, contact details).
- [Sign in](/auth): Sign-in page for Xboom team members.

## Optional

- [Home](/): Authenticated dashboard (requires sign-in).
